title: The agent that writes notes knows the notes rules, and a pre-copy check runs the notes lints, so a notes PR does not fail lane lint on wording
why: Owner, 11:01 CST Nov 18 (relayed by the consultant): PR 3548's five notes had to be split into one file each under docs/notes by a record-writer; it would have been better if what built them already knew the rule, so lint fails less. My own 342 J notes failed runner 10's lane lint four times (slug form and the retired name 'subagent'; glossary names in file names, 'owner's word' and 36 STE hits; one stale cite) before PR 3647 merged 10:56:50 CST Nov 18.
source: owner relay 11:01 CST Nov 18; runner 10 relay 10:57 CST Nov 18 (its tip: run check_glossary, ste_lint and stale_cites on a notes folder before it is copied)
note: Not built. Prior work searched 11:01 CST: agents/record-writer.md on main says nothing about notes or their lints; steps notes-new-only-layout and notes-slug-unique cover layout and slug uniqueness, not what a writer must know. Done when: (1) the record-writer agent file and the brief template say: one file per note, first line '- <file name>: text', no glossary avoided names in file names, no retired names, STE wording; (2) one named command runs check_glossary, ste_lint and stale_cites on a notes folder before it is copied or pushed. Next: a lane brief with a test-author first (a notes file with two bullets, a banned glossary word in a file name, and 'subagent' each fail the pre-copy command); mover: the coordinator's say-so. 11:04 CST ... 11:40 CST Nov 18 (triage 11): ALREADY ENFORCED (coordinator test-author read, relay 11:39 CST, no PR): lint/check_record_slugs.py bad_note_form (lines 169-185) refuses a docs/notes file that is not one "- ... 11:58 CST Nov 18: owner asked triage 11 to own the prose half (11:54 CST). Draft PR 3663 (agents/record-writer.md, 7 lines: notes form read from NOTE_LINE in check_record_slugs.py, notes lints before the report); lane lint running; triage merges it (one file) and sets this step done. 12:23 CST Nov 18: PR 3663 merged 12:21:39 CST (REST merged, head e50afb411a; round 1 haiku FAIL, round 2 sonnet FAIL, fix check sonnet PASS). The agent file now names the note form, reads it from NOTE_LINE, and lists the four lints to run before the report. The brief template line is not changed; a brief that gives another form is overruled by the agent file.
